title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Corridor 2 Road Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: Under the CAREC Corridor 2 Road Investment Program, the Project will comprise civil works for rehabilitating about 50 km of the Uzbekistan Section of CAREC Corridor 2 Road (between Km 440 and 490 of A380 highway), support to to the expansion and implementation of the road asset management system, and support capacity building for the Road Fund and the local communities living along the Investment Program road.

description.narrative: Better connectivity and an efficient transport system along the Uzbekistan section of the CAREC Corridor 2 Road

By 2015: Increased average total traffic volume from 1,000 vpd in 2009 to 1,800 vpd Progress/Status: Achieved. Annual average daily traffic reached 5,000 vpd in 2015. Data Source: - Statistical Review of Uzbekistan (annual publication of the Central Statistics Office)
- Periodic classified traffic counts (collected by Uzavtoyul) and the accident data system (collected by traffic police) Actual value:

By 2015: Travel time from Dautata to Bukhara reduced from 13 to 12 hours Progress/Status: Achieved. Travel time from Daut-ata to Bukhara reduced from 13 to 10.5 hours in 2013; on project road from 90 minutes to 35 minutes. Data Source: - Statistical Review of Uzbekistan (annual publication of the Central Statistics Office)
- Periodic classified traffic counts (collected by Uzavtoyul) and the accident data system (collected by traffic police) Actual value:

By 2015: Accident rate on the A380 highway reduced from 150 accidents per year (2008 estimate) to 120 Progress/Status: Achieved. Accident rate on A380 reduced to 6 in 2014; 5 fatal accidents and 1 serious accident. Data Source: - Statistical Review of Uzbekistan (annual publication of the Central Statistics Office)
- Periodic classified traffic counts (collected by Uzavtoyul) and the accident data system (collected by traffic police) Actual value:

By 2015: Road beneficiaries: 1.5 million population, 200 women Progress/Status: Achieved. 1.7 million population in Khorezm in 2014; 100 Sarimoy women received livelihood training from the Business Women's Association. More than 200 women received indirect benefits of this training. Data Source: - Statistical Review of Uzbekistan (annual publication of the Central Statistics Office)

Output: Uzbekistan section of the CAREC Corridor 2 Road constructed Indicator: By 2013: 50 km four-lane road sections constructed with an IR index of less than 4m/km Progress/Status: Achieved. A 50 km four-lane road section from Km 440 and Km 490 with IR index of 2 m/km (better than the 4 m/km target) was completed and accepted by the government in October 2014.
